Preserve the existing players and their distinct identities; no opposition players, no extra teammates and no new faces.

INPUT IMAGE 2 is the CUSTOMER'S ORIGINAL SELFIE and the DEFINITIVE, ONLY facial identity source for the central athlete. This is a strict photographic FACE REPLACEMENT, NOT creation of a similar-looking player. The central footballer must look like the ACTUAL PERSON in Image 2 rather than retaining Image 1's original face. Whenever the two faces conflict, the SELFIE FACE WINS. Preserve the customer's distinctive eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips and mouth proportions, cheek structure, jawline, chin, forehead, hairline, hair texture/colour, skin texture and apparent age. Do not retain the original model face, create a lookalike, beautify, age, masculinise, idealise, slim, exaggerate, stylise, smooth or invent new features. Blend the transferred FACE, EARS, JAW, NECK and visible upper skin seamlessly: consistent skin colour, brightness, texture and shadow direction under the SAME stadium floodlights, with no face-mask seam, different neck colour, pasted-on edge or mismatched tan. Preserve the master's physical pose and surrounding players without replacing their identities; never copy the selfie background. Keep the nighttime stadium; do not change to daytime.
